text:
cory: AM async — quick status check

cory: what I did: landed microbatch lock-reduction patch (PR #4822).
mina: saw the PR, looks good. ran a quick local smoke: +8% tail latency improvement on p95.
cory: blockers: kv warmup still causing cold tails on long seqs; canary in us-west2 hit a prefetch miss that OOM'd one pod.
elena: can you paste the canary logs?
cory: sure, snippet below:
```
[2026-03-15 04:21:12] kernel: prefetch miss; evict_candidate_count=3
[2026-03-15 04:21:12] kv_cache: async_warmup triggered for model-x, batch=12
[2026-03-15 04:21:12] runtime: alloc failure: requested=2.1G free=1.9G
```
ben: looks like the warmup spike + batch sizing pushed memory over the edge. might be the batching heuristic with `max_wait_ms=12` + `batch_size=32`.
cory: agreed. proposed quick mitigation: lower `max_wait_ms` to 8 and cap batch_size to 16 on the canary.
mina: bench numbers I ran this morning with `bench/run_p95.sh`:
- baseline (master): 120ms p95
- with microbatch PR only: 110ms p95
- microbatch + kv warmup disabled: 135ms p95

elena: hmm disabling warmup helps memory but hurts latency. can we tune warmup to be staggered instead of all-at-once?
ben: we have a lightweight staggered warmup prototype in infra branch `kv/stagger-2026` — might be worth cherry-picking the scheduler.
cory: good call. I'll prototype a staggered warmup window (spread across 3s) and test memory profile.
elena: small code review ping: @cory please address my inline comment about atomic-swap on the cache pointer before merging.
cory: ack, will do that today.
ben: infra ask: can we also emit `kv_warmup_hits` metric? dashboards currently infer it indirectly.
cory: yep adding `kv_warmup_hits` and `kv_warmup_inflight` in the runtime exporter. will add a migration note.
mina: on throughput tradeoffs — lowering `max_wait_ms` to 8ms reduced p95 to 105ms in my local canary run but dropped overall throughput by ~6%. that seems acceptable for tail-critical customers.
ben: +1 for 8ms in canary. we can always route less latency-sensitive traffic to dedicated pools.

cory: pushing canary config now: `max_wait_ms=8, batch_size_limit=16`
ops-bot: deploy: canary started for service=runtime-kernel region=us-west2 at ts=2317012400 — rolling 5 pods, image=runtime:v3.4.1-canary
mina: watching dashboards (p95, OOMs, mem usage). will report if any regressions.
elena: tagging perf ticket INF-678 with the microbatch numbers and OOM trace.
ben: FYI i'll queue a short infra postmortem template if canary flakes.
cory: thanks all — follow-ups: (1) staggered warmup prototype (me), (2) add metrics (me), (3) address CR comment (me), (4) bench run with canary config (mina).
cory: i'll post results here by EOD. :thumbsup:
